name: Gold Records
description: ROXIE came to JOHTO looking for a music scene and found temple bells and a sleeping WOOPER, so she is starting a band out of spite and you are her manager. Beat her in VIOLET CITY, track down the disguised bassist FEEDBACK in GOLDENROD's UNDERGROUND, then work out who kept time through a JIGGLYPUFF-interrupted drum audition in ECRUTEAK. ALPHA: the band is half-assembled -- promotion, the gig and PIERS are still to come. POKEMON GOLD ONLY; this mod does not load on Red, Blue or Yellow.
